Usage Notes
fields.options: Configure visual branding and seller contact details here. For new finalized sales, populated Seller Identity fields in FBR Settings override the matching legal name, address and NTN values. Ledgix freezes the resolved seller identity on each finalized Sale, so later settings edits do not rewrite historical receipts or invoices.
